location: Western Forests — Old-growth elven forests west of the fort.
rewardEnvelope: the pay is honest coin, and any small spoils besides
stakeIfLost: If the company fails, the hiring shrine will lose the garter relic and so fail to open the buried vault that holds its pledged trove of pilgrim offerings.
arrival: came in the night and would not wait for morning · brought no one with them
OPPOSES: necromancer · hold the Hearthwyd Vault and its contents against any claimant

cast.name: Gille
cast.who: a middling priest at a small riverside shrine who keeps careful pledges and asks favors plainly.
cast.want: to recover the garter relic and have it delivered into the hiring shrine's custody

bible.goal: Recover the garter relic claimed by the hiring shrine and return it into that shrine's custody.

relevantLore.name: Hearthwyd Vault
relevantLore.blurb: A buried shrine vault under the grove, sealed and defended by rites.

arcStep: Go to the hiring shrine Gille named to take the shrine's claim and ask for proof and leads
